ambiguities.text: The index page only shows file structure without specific bomb delay offset value.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Use known Arrow Glacier specification: bomb delay offset is 10,700,000 blocks, fork activates at block 13,773,000.

ambiguities.text: No explicit statement about other protocol rules remaining unchanged from London.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume Arrow Glacier only modifies difficulty bomb delay; all other rules (EIP-1559, gas limit, etc.) remain as in London fork.

implicit_assumptions.description: The difficulty bomb delay is temporary; the bomb will eventually trigger if no further delays or the merge occurs.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If viewed as permanent removal, network participants may not properly plan for eventual bomb detonation.

implicit_assumptions.description: All Ethereum clients will upgrade to Arrow Glacier before block 13,773,000.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Non-upgraded clients would fork off the main chain due to difficulty calculation mismatch.

implicit_assumptions.description: The Merge (transition to Proof of Stake) will occur before the delayed bomb becomes significant again.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If Merge is delayed beyond bomb effectivity, block times would increase significantly, potentially requiring another bomb delay fork.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot exploit the bomb delay to manipulate difficulty for selfish mining advantage.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Predictable difficulty patterns due to bomb delay could be exploited for timing attacks on block production.
